partially_covered.missing: Organization class still only models address and GLN; lacks contact details, legal identifiers, VAT, and other attributes. No enrichment since last review.
ValidationConstraint class remains unstructured; no SHACL shape modeling or explicit mandatory field restrictions. Directory requirements not formalized.

cq_coverage.details: Coverage remains strong for most CQs, but CQ5 and CQ13 are still only partially addressed. No new CQs were added or dropped. No improvement in these areas since prior iteration.

issues: SectionUnion remains a blank node (_:SectionUnion) in disjointUnionOf, which may cause tooling and reasoner issues.

weaknesses: No GCAs for complex class definitions
SectionUnion uses blank node, which may cause tooling issues

likely_oops_pitfalls: P7: SectionUnion blank node may be nonstandard
P22: No GCAs or advanced class axioms

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand Organization class to include additional attributes (e.g., contact info, legal identifiers, VAT number, etc.) and link them with new data properties.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Full coverage for CQ5 and improved organizational detail

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Formalize ValidationConstraint class with explicit SHACL shapes or mandatory property restrictions to ensure CQ13 is fully addressed.
Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) for key concepts, e.g. define Buyer as Organization with BuyerRole in InvoiceMessage.
Replace blank node _:SectionUnion with a named class for easier tool compatibility.
Add more advanced property characteristics (e.g., inverse properties, cardinality restrictions) where appropriate.

summary: The ontology remains robust and covers most competency questions, with deep hierarchies and strong OWL 2 compliance. However, none of the high or medium priority improvements from the previous review were implemented—especially regarding organizational detail and validation constraints. Quality and coverage scores are unchanged, and some structural issues persist, notably the use of a blank node for SectionUnion.

suggestions_ignored: Expand Organization class with additional attributes

improvement_tracking.notes: No significant progress since last review. The ontology is stable and compliant, but missed opportunities for enrichment and structural improvement. High-priority suggestions should be addressed next iteration.
